note: One table for the address rule of Settings -> Services, read by tests/service-url.test.js (the server) and tests/web/service-url.test.js (the browser's copy of the rule). An http:// address must name its port; an https:// address needs none. 'stored' is the address the server keeps; 'problem' is the sentence both sides show; 'invalid' means the server refuses it with its general message and the browser's rule has nothing to add.
